memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular rate.
Patient reports mild exertional dyspnea, no palpitations on admission. ECG shows irregularly irregular rhythm, rate 78 bpm. Lung fields clear, no wheeze. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% pred), FVC 3.30 L (88% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.86; change from prior +0.02 L. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: correct (uses salbutamol MDI prn). Smoking status: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Apixaban 5 mg twice daily
Bisoprolol 2.5 mg once daily
Levothyroxine 50 mcg once daily

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 4.2 mIU/L (0.4-4.0) slightly high
Free T4 11.2 pmol/L (12-22) low
INR 1.1 (target 2-3 if on warfarin)
Serum creatinine 78 µmol/L (60-110) normal

memories.author: D05
memories.text: 12-lead ECG: Irregularly irregular rhythm, no discernible P waves, ventricular rate 80 bpm. No ST-T changes. Consistent with atrial fibrillation.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Penicillin allergy: rash and pruritus within 30 minutes of last dose.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Hypothyroidism, suboptimally replaced.
Patient notes fatigue, weight gain 2 kg over 2 months. Dry skin, mild constipation. Exam: BMI 28, pulse 76 regular. Spirometry: FEV1 2.80 L (90% pred), FVC 3.25 L (87% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.86; change -0.05 L. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: correct. Smoking status: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Levothyroxine 75 mcg once daily (increase from 50 mcg)

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 2.8 mIU/L (0.4-4.0) now within range
Free T4 14.5 pmol/L (12-22) normal
INR 1.2
Serum creatinine 80 µmol/L

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve felt occasional fluttering in my chest when climbing stairs, lasting a few seconds. No dizziness or chest pain.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to cardiology for evaluation of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and consideration of rhythm control strategy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cardiology review: Confirmed paroxysmal AF. Recommend continuing apixaban for stroke prophylaxis, bisoprolol for rate control. No immediate need for ablation. Follow-up in 3 months.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Atrial fibrillation, rate controlled on bisoprolol.
Patient denies further palpitations since last visit. Exam: regular rhythm 72 bpm, lungs clear. Spirometry: FEV1 2.88 L (93% pred), FVC 3.32 L (89% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.87; change +0.03 L. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: correct. Smoking status: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Bisoprolol increased to 5 mg once daily
Warfarin initiated 5 mg once daily (INR target 2-3)

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed from 2026-02-15 to 2026-02-10 at 10:00 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Hypothyroidism well replaced.
Patient reports improved energy, weight stable. Exam: pulse 78 regular, no edema. Spirometry: FEV1 2.90 L (94% pred), FVC 3.35 L (90% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.87; change +0.02 L. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: correct. Smoking status: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Levothyroxine increased to 100 mcg once daily (from 75 mcg)

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 1.9 mIU/L (0.4-4.0) optimal
Free T4 15.8 pmol/L (12-22) normal
INR 2.4 (within target 2-3)
Serum creatinine 82 µmol/L
